plain_text:
Willard Waterman appears in 225 recordings across 10 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1947 to 1957. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Willard Waterman most often in The Great Gildersleeve, The Whistler, The Halls of Ivy, Lux Radio Theatre, Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Screen Directors Playhouse, Father Knows Best, and Escape.

Characters credited here include Throckmorton P. Gildersleeve.
